whyRequired: Two natural detached rocks plus irregular vegetated shore are source object identities. No approved modern semantic artwork asset was located. A deterministic made-up rock/vegetation freeform is not a faithful substitute.

plannedRasterAsset.purpose: Natural-object base layer only; no mathematical wave layer.
content: One irregular left bank extending toward lower foreground and a horizontal upper distant-bank strip, with branching vegetation of natural appearance; no invented species labels.
Exactly two detached exposed rocks in open water, one substantially larger and craggy, one much smaller, preserving the source scene's relative roles.
Water surface sufficiently clear for a later independent deterministic wave layer; no generated crest geometry, calibrated shadow boundary or plotted dimensions.
forbidden: Readable labels, figure number, axes, ticks, numeric values, wavefront circles, drawn ray arrows or equations.
Additional isolated rocks, ambiguous merged rock silhouettes or removal of the bank/vegetation identity.
Using arbitrary SVG polygons/freeforms as pretend natural semantic artwork.
plannedRasterAsset.placement: Final placement, viewpoint and composition must be bound to complete authoritative ZH/EN context and separately directed FigureSpec. No coordinates or speculative wave draft assigned now.

plannedDeterministicLayer.purpose: Later control the qualitative wavelength/obstacle-size comparison and surrounding wavefront relationships without generative physics or treating unlined source paper as exact zero field.
plannedDeterministicLayer.constraints: No unprinted numerical size ratio or wavefront count. Modern source-era categorical wording and any needed qualification remain the text author's scope; no reauthoring here.
